title: What If You Ran a Marathon Every Day for a Year? One Man Did

scenes.text: What if you ran a marathon every day for a year? One man ran 401.
That is 26.2 miles a day. In total he covered about 10,500 miles, roughly London to Sydney.
In his first 50 days he lost 17 kilograms, because eating enough to match the running turned out to be nearly impossible.
Over the whole run he burned about 2.9 million calories, roughly four years of a typical adult's food.
He said the first weeks were physical. Once his body adapted, keeping a positive mind became the harder challenge.
He finished in Bristol after 401 days, with more than 9,000 people joining parts of the run. Legs adapt faster than heads.

description:
What if you ran a marathon every day for a year?
Ben Smith ran 401 in 401 days, about 10,500 miles, and said the hard part changed once his body adapted.
